Job Description: AI Engineer

Company: Ariqt Global Technologies

Experience: 2–5 Years

Employment Type: Full-time

Location: Hyderabad, Telangana.

About Ariqt Global Technologies

At Ariqt Global Technologies, we are passionate about building innovative, AI-powered solutions that solve real-world business problems. We are looking for a passionate Software Engineer – AI who loves coding, enjoys experimenting with emerging technologies, and is excited about building intelligent, scalable, and production-ready AI applications.

If you are enthusiastic about LLMs, Agentic AI, AI-powered engineering, and next-generation software architecture, and have an entrepreneurial mindset to turn ideas into impactful products, we would love to have you on our team.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly motivated Software Engineer – AI with 2–5 years of software development experience and a strong interest in AI engineering. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI, AI-assisted development tools, and modern software engineering practices.

You will be responsible for designing, developing, and deploying AI-powered applications, building intelligent agents, integrating AI models into enterprise solutions, and leveraging AI tools to accelerate software development and innovation.

We value engineering excellence, ownership, curiosity, and a passion for coding over familiarity with any one specific technology.

Key Responsibilities

AI & LLM Engineering: Design, develop, and integrate LLM-powered applications using models and frameworks such as OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain, LangGraph, and other emerging AI technologies.
Agentic AI Development: Build AI agents, multi-agent workflows, tool-calling systems, and autonomous AI solutions to automate complex business processes.
AI-Assisted Software Engineering: Leverage AI coding assistants and development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude, and other AI-powered tools to improve developer productivity and code quality.
Harness Engineering: Develop and maintain the infrastructure, tools, evaluation loops, guardrails, context management, and feedback mechanisms that enable AI agents and coding systems to operate reliably.
Software Development: Write clean, maintainable, scalable, and production-ready code while following industry best practices and modern software development principles.
Solution Architecture: Contribute to designing end-to-end technical solutions, including system architecture, APIs, microservices, integrations, and cloud-native applications.
Engineering Best Practices: Apply SOLID principles, design patterns, clean architecture, CI/CD, automated testing, and secure coding practices.
AI Integration: Build RAG-based applications, vector search solutions, knowledge retrieval systems, and AI-driven automation workflows.
Problem Solving: Analyze complex technical and business challenges and develop practical, innovative, and scalable solutions.
Collaboration & Ownership: Work closely with cross-functional teams, product stakeholders, and leadership to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
Continuous Innovation: Stay updated with emerging AI technologies, experiment with new tools and frameworks, and proactively identify opportunities to leverage AI.

Required Technical Skills

Programming & Software Engineering

Strong proficiency in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript.
Solid understanding of object-oriented programming, data structures, algorithms, and problem-solving.
Good knowledge of REST APIs, backend development, databases, and application integration.
Experience with Git, version control, debugging, testing, and CI/CD practices.

LLMs & Generative AI

Hands-on knowledge of LLMs, including GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, or similar models.
Understanding of prompt engineering, structured outputs, function calling, and context management.
Experience with LLM frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or equivalent.
Knowledge of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), embeddings, vector databases, and semantic search.
Understanding of LLM evaluation, hallucination mitigation, latency, and cost optimization.

Agentic AI & AI Engineering

Understanding of Agentic AI architectures, AI agents, tool use, planning, memory, and orchestration.
Exposure to multi-agent systems and frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar.
Ability to design AI workflows that combine LLMs with APIs, databases, and external tools.
Knowledge of agent observability, evaluation, guardrails, and reliability engineering.
Familiarity with harness engineering, including agent execution environments, context engineering, test-driven feedback loops, and controlled tool access.

AI Development Tools

Hands-on experience or strong familiarity with AI coding assistants such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or similar tools.
Ability to use AI tools effectively for code generation, refactoring, debugging, test creation, and documentation.
Understanding of AI-assisted development workflows, code reviews, and validating AI-generated code.
Willingness to continuously experiment with new AI tools and development methodologies.

Architecture & Engineering Principles

Strong understanding of SOLID principles, object-oriented design, and software design patterns.
Knowledge of clean architecture, modular design, microservices, and distributed systems.
Understanding of scalable application design, API design, security, and performance optimization.
Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Exposure to Docker, Kubernetes, serverless architecture, and deployment automation is an advantage.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building and deploying AI-powered applications in real-world or production environments.
Exposure to end-to-end solution architecture and technical design.
Experience with vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, or pgvector.
Knowledge of agent evaluation, tracing, observability, and AI testing frameworks.
Experience with SQL/NoSQL databases and cloud-native application development.
Contributions to open-source projects, personal AI projects, hackathons, or technical communities.
A strong portfolio of AI applications, GitHub repositories, or demonstrable technical projects.

Soft Skills & Mindset

Entrepreneurial Mindset: Think like a founder, take initiative, identify opportunities, and turn ideas into working solutions.
Passion for Coding: A genuine love for writing code, experimenting with technologies, and building products.
Ownership & Accountability: Take end-to-end ownership of tasks, from ideation and design to development, deployment, and support.
Excellent Communication: Clearly articulate technical concepts, communicate ideas effectively, and collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Problem-Solving Ability: Strong analytical and logical thinking with the ability to break down complex challenges into practical solutions.
Learning Agility: Be curious, adaptable, and eager to learn and apply rapidly evolving AI technologies.
Innovation & Execution: Be comfortable with ambiguity, think creatively, move fast, and focus on delivering measurable outcomes.
Team Player: Collaborate effectively while being capable of independently driving initiatives.

What We Offer

The opportunity to work on cutting-edge LLMs, Agentic AI, and next-generation AI-powered products.
A fast-paced, innovation-driven environment with significant technical ownership.
Opportunities to experiment with emerging AI technologies and shape engineering practices.
Exposure to end-to-end product development, solution architecture, and enterprise AI implementations.
A culture that values entrepreneurial thinking, creativity, continuous learning, and engineering excellence.
The opportunity to make a meaningful impact on the company’s AI-driven growth and innovation journey.

Who Should Apply?

We are looking for engineers who don’t just want to write code but are passionate about building products, solving meaningful problems, and pushing the boundaries of AI.

If you enjoy experimenting with LLMs, building intelligent agents, using AI to become a better engineer, and taking ownership of solutions from concept to deployment, this role at Ariqt Global Technologies is for you.

Summary

Position Summary

Custom AI

Customer | S&S | Consultant

About The Role

Deloitte is seeking a Full Stack CRM Developer to help design, build, and deliver bespoke, AI-augmented Customer Relationship Management applications. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone early in their consulting career who wants to build modern, scalable customer engagement platforms — not configure off-the-shelf tools.

You will work under the guidance of Senior Consultants, Managers, and Architects to build features, integrate AI capabilities, and deliver high-quality, well-tested code across the full stack. This role is designed to build deep technical skills in CRM engineering and GenAI integration while developing the foundation for future architecture and leadership roles at Deloitte.

Key Responsibilities

Architecture & Solution Design (Contributor)
Build components of custom CRM platforms — including data models, API endpoints, microservices, and front-end features — following the architecture patterns and standards set by the engagement's architects.
Develop full-stack features using modern frameworks (React, Angular, Next.js) for frontend and Node.js or Python/FastAPI for backend, under the direction of senior technical leads.
Follow established architecture governance standards and reusable microservice patterns; raise opportunities for improvement to senior architects.
Support build vs. buy evaluations by prototyping and testing candidate approaches as directed.
Product & Delivery Mindset
Participate in discovery sprints and user feedback sessions; help translate business pain points into user stories and backlog items.
Support a product mindset by helping track adoption and usage metrics for the features you deliver.
Participate in innovation labs and internal hackathons, prototyping emerging CRM capabilities under guidance from senior team members.
Contribute code, tests, and documentation to Deloitte's CRM accelerators and reference architectures.
Stay current on emerging technologies (agentic frameworks, LLM tooling, edge inference) and share relevant findings with the team.
AI, GenAI & Agentic Integration
Build and test AI/GenAI features within CRM workflows — such as lead-scoring models, content generation, and chatbot integrations — as specified by the architecture team.
Support development of RAG pipelines and LLM orchestration components (LangChain, LlamaIndex) under senior guidance.
Implement token-usage tracking and basic semantic caching per the engagement's established cost governance framework.
Assist with deploying and testing inference-serving components, including containerized vLLM or managed inference endpoints.
Build and test conversational AI features (chatbots, virtual agents), validating functionality against defined latency SLAs (e.g., Support output-validation and hallucination-detection testing as part of GenAI QA processes.
Help capture basic AI usage metrics (cost-per-interaction, latency, accuracy) for reporting to senior team members.
AI Implementation Fundamentals

Area

What This Level Does

Data First

Execute data-quality checks and CRM hygiene tasks (deduplication, completeness scoring) as defined by the team's data standards, before AI features are deployed.

Scalability by Design

Build components following the team's established autoscaling and async-queue patterns rather than introducing one-off solutions.

Cost Efficiency

Apply caching and token-budget practices defined by the engagement; monitor and report token spend for the features you own.

Adaptable Architecture

Build modular, configurable components (prompt layers, pluggable services) rather than hard-coded logic, per team design guidance.

Change & Adoption

Build intuitive UX per design specifications and help instrument usage/engagement metrics; surface adoption friction observed during testing.

Ethical AI

Apply bias-detection and fairness-testing checklists provided by senior architects when validating model outputs.

Integration Support
Build integrations with legacy systems, ERPs, MDM platforms, and third-party tools using REST, SOAP, GraphQL, and event-driven patterns (Kafka, RabbitMQ), following designs provided by senior architects.
Support integration of the CRM with marketing automation platforms, communication APIs (Email, SMS, WhatsApp), and data lake/warehouse environments (Snowflake, Databricks).
Database Development & Performance
Build and maintain relational and non-relational data models per designs provided by senior architects; implement indexing and partitioning as specified.
Support performance-tuning tasks: query optimization, connection pooling, and cache implementation using Redis/Memcached.
Write and maintain SQL/NoSQL code across PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, and Cassandra environments.
Security, Compliance & Cloud Engineering
Implement security controls (RBAC, OAuth2/SAML, field-level encryption, audit logging) in line with compliance requirements (GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA).
Build and deploy containerized services on AWS, Azure, or GCP using Docker and Kubernetes; contribute to CI/CD pipelines.
Delivery Excellence
Deliver high-quality, well-tested code that adheres to team coding standards; participate actively in code reviews.
Support migration and modernization workstreams under senior direction.
Flag technical risks, blockers, and dependencies to project leads in a timely manner.
Practice & Community Contribution
Contribute to internal accelerators, code libraries, and technical documentation.
Support the creation of point-of-view content and client-ready materials under the guidance of senior team members.
Participate in Deloitte's technical communities of practice and knowledge-sharing sessions.

Required Qualifications

3-6 years of experience in software development, with exposure to CRM system design or customer data platforms a plus.
2+ years of hands-on full-stack development using modern web frameworks (React, Angular, or Vue) and backends (Node.js, Python, or Java).
Working knowledge of CRM domain concepts — Leads, Opportunities, Account Management, Sales Pipelines, Service Cases.
Foundational understanding of AI/ML concepts as applied to CRM (lead scoring, recommendation logic, conversational AI).
Exposure to GenAI frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex) or LLM integration patterns (RAG, function calling) through coursework, personal projects, or prior engagements.
Familiarity with relational (PostgreSQL, SQL Server) and NoSQL (MongoDB, Cassandra) databases.
Experience integrating applications via REST, SOAP, or GraphQL APIs.
Exposure to cloud-native deployment (AWS, Azure, or GCP) using Docker/Kubernetes.
Basic understanding of security and compliance concepts (OAuth2, SAML, RBAC, GDPR/CCPA/HIPAA).
Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively within cross-functional delivery teams.
Experience contributing to a delivery POD or project team of roughly 3-6 engineers or equivalent team-based project work.

Preferred Qualifications

Personal, academic, or hackathon projects involving LLM integration, RAG, or agentic frameworks.
Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi).
Cloud certifications at the Associate level (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
Prior internship, co-op, or project experience in a consulting or client-facing environment.

Core Competencies

Competency

Description

Strategic Thinking

Understands how assigned tasks connect to broader business outcomes; asks clarifying questions to align work with client goals.

Product Mindset

Understands the product being built; contributes input on backlog items and incorporates user feedback into delivered work.

Innovation Drive

Curious about emerging technologies; experiments in labs/hackathons and shares findings with the team.

AI & GenAI Fluency

Builds and tests AI/GenAI features under guidance; developing foundational RAG and LLM integration skills.

Technical Excellence

Writes clean, tested, well-documented code; follows engineering best practices and team coding standards.

Architecture Awareness

Follows established architecture standards and design principles; escalates gaps or inconsistencies to senior architects.

Client Centricity

Translates specific requirements into working code; asks questions to clarify ambiguity before building.

Communication

Communicates clearly with team leads and peers; developing confidence presenting work to internal stakeholders.

Growth Mindset

Actively seeks feedback and mentorship; supports peers through pairing, reviews, and knowledge sharing.

Why Deloitte?

Deloitte Consulting's Technology & Digital Transformation practice is a trusted advisor to the world's leading enterprises. As a Full Stack CRM Developer, you will build the technical foundation of your consulting career — working alongside world-class engineers and architects on real, high-impact AI-native CRM platforms.

At Deloitte, we believe that together makes progress. You will build products that outlast engagements, learn from experienced architects and managers, and grow within a practice where curiosity and continuous learning are part of the daily discipline.

Deloitte is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

#CustomAI

Our purpose

Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Experience with Git, version control, debugging, testing, and CI/CD practices.

Knowledge of clean architecture, modular design, microservices, and distributed systems.
Understanding of scalable application design, API design, security, and performance optimization.
Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Exposure to Docker, Kubernetes, serverless architecture, and deployment automation is an advantage.

Experience building and deploying AI-powered applications in real-world or production environments.
Exposure to end-to-end solution architecture and technical design.
Experience with vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, or pgvector.
Knowledge of agent evaluation, tracing, observability, and AI testing frameworks.
Experience with SQL/NoSQL databases and cloud-native application development.
Contributions to open-source projects, personal AI projects, hackathons, or technical communities.
A strong portfolio of AI applications, GitHub repositories, or demonstrable technical projects.

Soft Skills & Mindset

Entrepreneurial Mindset: Think like a founder, take initiative, identify opportunities, and turn ideas into working solutions.
Passion for Coding: A genuine love for writing code, experimenting with technologies, and building products.

Job Description

We are looking for a highly skilled, deeply hands-on Full-Stack Software Engineer who will cover frontend UI, backend architecture, cloud deployment, and DevOps engineering all under one hat. Since our team already includes dedicated AI Engineers and Data Engineers, your primary mission is to be the foundational software engineering anchor: building the robust, scalable, and secure user interfaces, infrastructure, integrations, and server-side logic that allows our AI solutions to thrive in a production environment.

Core Backend Engineering & API Design:

Cloud Architecture & DevOps Excellence:

Agentic SDLC & Engineering Excellence:

Experience:
7+ years of strong software engineering experience with a demonstrable focus on backend development, cloud infrastructure, advanced frontend architecture, and DevOps.

AI Integration Experience:
Proven experience building backends for complex solutions and AI / LLM-powered applications, managing streaming responses, and translating non-deterministic AI outputs into safe, functional user interfaces.

Agentic Workflow:
Proven experience leveraging AI coding agents within an agentic SDLC to accelerate feature delivery.

Hold a B.Sc., B.Eng., M.Sc., M.Eng., PhD, or equivalent in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.

Be a passionate builder, staying continuously up-to-date with the latest developments in cloud computing, backend architectures, frontend paradigms, and AI integrations.

Be team-oriented, proactive, and collaborative, thriving in a fast-paced environment where roles are fluid and multidisciplinary.

Have a deep sense of accountability, capable of diagnosing complex system-level issues across the entire stack, and able to step into a Tech Lead role when necessary.

Software Engineering Best Practices:
Robust automated testing (TDD) to verify both code written by AI agents and dynamic UI components generated at runtime.

Frontend & User Interface:
Deep expertise in TypeScript and a major framework (React/Next.js or Angular 16+). Strong capability in complex state management and handling real-time data flow.

Backend Programming:
Advanced, production-grade proficiency in Python. Excellent enterprise API design and microservices architecture skills.

Cloud & DevOps:
Deep expertise in AWS (IAM, Lambda, S3, ECS, etc.), Docker, CI/CD tools (e.g., GitHub Actions), and Terraform.

APIs and integrations:
Building API-driven applications and integrating different enterprise systems into one solution.

Position Summary

Custom AI

Customer | S&S | Consultant

About The Role

Deloitte is seeking a Full Stack CRM Developer to help design, build, and deliver bespoke, AI-augmented Customer Relationship Management applications. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone early in their consulting career who wants to build modern, scalable customer engagement platforms — not configure off-the-shelf tools.

You will work under the guidance of Senior Consultants, Managers, and Architects to build features, integrate AI capabilities, and deliver high-quality, well-tested code across the full stack. This role is designed to build deep technical skills in CRM engineering and GenAI integration while developing the foundation for future architecture and leadership roles at Deloitte.

Key Responsibilities

Architecture & Solution Design (Contributor)
Build components of custom CRM platforms — including data models, API endpoints, microservices, and front-end features — following the architecture patterns and standards set by the engagement's architects.
Develop full-stack features using modern frameworks (React, Angular, Next.js) for frontend and Node.js or Python/FastAPI for backend, under the direction of senior technical leads.
Follow established architecture governance standards and reusable microservice patterns; raise opportunities for improvement to senior architects.
Support build vs. buy evaluations by prototyping and testing candidate approaches as directed.
Product & Delivery Mindset
Participate in discovery sprints and user feedback sessions; help translate business pain points into user stories and backlog items.
Support a product mindset by helping track adoption and usage metrics for the features you deliver.
Participate in innovation labs and internal hackathons, prototyping emerging CRM capabilities under guidance from senior team members.
Contribute code, tests, and documentation to Deloitte's CRM accelerators and reference architectures.
Stay current on emerging technologies (agentic frameworks, LLM tooling, edge inference) and share relevant findings with the team.
AI, GenAI & Agentic Integration
Build and test AI/GenAI features within CRM workflows — such as lead-scoring models, content generation, and chatbot integrations — as specified by the architecture team.
Support development of RAG pipelines and LLM orchestration components (LangChain, LlamaIndex) under senior guidance.
Implement token-usage tracking and basic semantic caching per the engagement's established cost governance framework.
Assist with deploying and testing inference-serving components, including containerized vLLM or managed inference endpoints.
Build and test conversational AI features (chatbots, virtual agents), validating functionality against defined latency SLAs (e.g., Support output-validation and hallucination-detection testing as part of GenAI QA processes.
Help capture basic AI usage metrics (cost-per-interaction, latency, accuracy) for reporting to senior team members.
AI Implementation Fundamentals

Area

What This Level Does

Data First

Execute data-quality checks and CRM hygiene tasks (deduplication, completeness scoring) as defined by the team's data standards, before AI features are deployed.

Scalability by Design

Build components following the team's established autoscaling and async-queue patterns rather than introducing one-off solutions.

Cost Efficiency

Apply caching and token-budget practices defined by the engagement; monitor and report token spend for the features you own.

Adaptable Architecture

Build modular, configurable components (prompt layers, pluggable services) rather than hard-coded logic, per team design guidance.

Change & Adoption

Build intuitive UX per design specifications and help instrument usage/engagement metrics; surface adoption friction observed during testing.

Ethical AI

Apply bias-detection and fairness-testing checklists provided by senior architects when validating model outputs.

Integration Support
Build integrations with legacy systems, ERPs, MDM platforms, and third-party tools using REST, SOAP, GraphQL, and event-driven patterns (Kafka, RabbitMQ), following designs provided by senior architects.
Support integration of the CRM with marketing automation platforms, communication APIs (Email, SMS, WhatsApp), and data lake/warehouse environments (Snowflake, Databricks).
Database Development & Performance
Build and maintain relational and non-relational data models per designs provided by senior architects; implement indexing and partitioning as specified.
Support performance-tuning tasks: query optimization, connection pooling, and cache implementation using Redis/Memcached.
Write and maintain SQL/NoSQL code across PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, and Cassandra environments.
Security, Compliance & Cloud Engineering
Implement security controls (RBAC, OAuth2/SAML, field-level encryption, audit logging) in line with compliance requirements (GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA).
Build and deploy containerized services on AWS, Azure, or GCP using Docker and Kubernetes; contribute to CI/CD pipelines.
Delivery Excellence
Deliver high-quality, well-tested code that adheres to team coding standards; participate actively in code reviews.
Support migration and modernization workstreams under senior direction.
Flag technical risks, blockers, and dependencies to project leads in a timely manner.
Practice & Community Contribution
Contribute to internal accelerators, code libraries, and technical documentation.
Support the creation of point-of-view content and client-ready materials under the guidance of senior team members.
Participate in Deloitte's technical communities of practice and knowledge-sharing sessions.

Required Qualifications

3-6 years of experience in software development, with exposure to CRM system design or customer data platforms a plus.
2+ years of hands-on full-stack development using modern web frameworks (React, Angular, or Vue) and backends (Node.js, Python, or Java).
Working knowledge of CRM domain concepts — Leads, Opportunities, Account Management, Sales Pipelines, Service Cases.
Foundational understanding of AI/ML concepts as applied to CRM (lead scoring, recommendation logic, conversational AI).
Exposure to GenAI frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex) or LLM integration patterns (RAG, function calling) through coursework, personal projects, or prior engagements.
Familiarity with relational (PostgreSQL, SQL Server) and NoSQL (MongoDB, Cassandra) databases.
Experience integrating applications via REST, SOAP, or GraphQL APIs.
Exposure to cloud-native deployment (AWS, Azure, or GCP) using Docker/Kubernetes.
Basic understanding of security and compliance concepts (OAuth2, SAML, RBAC, GDPR/CCPA/HIPAA).
Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively within cross-functional delivery teams.
Experience contributing to a delivery POD or project team of roughly 3-6 engineers or equivalent team-based project work.

Preferred Qualifications

Personal, academic, or hackathon projects involving LLM integration, RAG, or agentic frameworks.
Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi).
Cloud certifications at the Associate level (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
Prior internship, co-op, or project experience in a consulting or client-facing environment.

Core Competencies

Competency

Description

Strategic Thinking

Understands how assigned tasks connect to broader business outcomes; asks clarifying questions to align work with client goals.

Product Mindset

Understands the product being built; contributes input on backlog items and incorporates user feedback into delivered work.

Innovation Drive

Curious about emerging technologies; experiments in labs/hackathons and shares findings with the team.

AI & GenAI Fluency

Builds and tests AI/GenAI features under guidance; developing foundational RAG and LLM integration skills.

Technical Excellence

Writes clean, tested, well-documented code; follows engineering best practices and team coding standards.

Architecture Awareness

Follows established architecture standards and design principles; escalates gaps or inconsistencies to senior architects.

Client Centricity

Translates specific requirements into working code; asks questions to clarify ambiguity before building.

Communication

Communicates clearly with team leads and peers; developing confidence presenting work to internal stakeholders.

Growth Mindset

Actively seeks feedback and mentorship; supports peers through pairing, reviews, and knowledge sharing.

Why Deloitte?

Deloitte Consulting's Technology & Digital Transformation practice is a trusted advisor to the world's leading enterprises. As a Full Stack CRM Developer, you will build the technical foundation of your consulting career — working alongside world-class engineers and architects on real, high-impact AI-native CRM platforms.

At Deloitte, we believe that together makes progress. You will build products that outlast engagements, learn from experienced architects and managers, and grow within a practice where curiosity and continuous learning are part of the daily discipline.

Deloitte is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria.
